attributes.title: SEMPA 360 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
SEMPA 360 2027, the annual conference of the Society of Emergency Medicine PAs, takes place in Nashville, Tennessee. SEMPA's save-the-date gives March 30 to April 3, 2027, while its event calendar lists March 30 to April 2 at the Omni Hotel; pre-conference workshops start March 30.

Full registration is $690 for SEMPA members and eligible military, $990 for non-members and $450 for PA student members. Optional hands-on workshops run by USACS cost extra: critical procedures ($350), ultrasound ($350), airway ($325) and slit lamp ($250), each with limited seats.

SEMPA awards CME credit for SEMPA 360, claimed through its CME site after the conference evaluation. The credit type and number of hours for 2027 have not been published yet.
